un-n.label: GT batters ranked
un-n.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
un-n.query: SELECT pl.name, f.runs, f.balls_faced balls FROM fact_batting_innings f JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = f.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = i.match_id JOIN players pl ON pl.player_id = f.striker_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND i.batting_team_id IN (14) AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2024 AND 2026 AND f.balls_faced > 0
